name: sysmac-project-interpretation
description: 100% AI-generated plugin for interpreting saved Omron Sysmac projects and comparing revisions using source evidence.

interface.longDescription: 100% AI-generated: all plugin code, scripts, instructions, documentation, and tests were generated by AI. Decode saved .smc2 projects, trace task assignments, ladder and inline ST, examine sequence recovery and PLC/HMI dependencies, and compare revisions. Includes a Python helper and focused interpretation references. Raw archive decoding requires file access and Python execution in the session.
defaultPrompt: Interpret this Sysmac project and explain its scheduled programs, main sequences, and important dependencies.
Compare these Sysmac revisions and explain the behavior changes with source evidence.
Trace this sequence through its requests, acknowledgements, faults, reset, and restart behavior.
